summary: Fermi Inc. filed an 8-K to announce a $350 million convertible senior notes offering due 2031, with a $52.5 million overallotment option, under Rule 144A to QIBs. The proceeds will fund capped call transactions and general corporate purposes. The filing also includes a preliminary offering memorandum and updated investor presentation. No terms such as conversion price, interest rate, or maturity spread are given. This is a routine capital markets transaction (convertible debt offering) by the issuer for financing, not a special situation. What to watch: pricing and use of capped call economics.
